notes: «وَ مُحَمَّدٌ اَلْحَلَبِيُّ» is a co-transmitter in the same level as عبيد الله
the Imam is inside the chain after «عن», so he is a narrator; the matn names him again («قُدِّمَ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ») as the same person, so occurrence 1 marks the chain
the merchants in the matn are subjects, not links
